items.data_sentence: My supervisor says we need a motif prior; I have RNA-seq from 40 mouse lungs collected five days after influenza or mock infection.
items.purpose_sentence: Which transcription factors drive the antiviral genes in these lungs, and how do their targets change with infection?
items.prompt: My supervisor says we need a motif prior; I have RNA-seq from 40 mouse lungs collected five days after influenza or mock infection. Which transcription factors drive the antiviral genes in these lungs, and how do their targets change with infection?
must_include: asks whether they actually have a motif prior and a PPI network
does not treat the supervisor's remark as having the prior
red_flags: treats the motif prior as already in hand
recommends a TF network as ready to run

items.data_sentence: Last year we used JASPAR motifs and a STRING network on a different pig cohort; this year we have RNA-seq from 52 piglet jejunum samples, half weaned early.
items.purpose_sentence: How do transcription factor networks differ between early-weaned and later-weaned piglets?
items.prompt: Last year we used JASPAR motifs and a STRING network on a different pig cohort; this year we have RNA-seq from 52 piglet jejunum samples, half weaned early. How do transcription factor networks differ between early-weaned and later-weaned piglets?
must_include: asks whether the motif prior and PPI network are available for this dataset
notes last year's resources could be reused or rebuilt for this cohort
red_flags: treats last year's priors as stated for this dataset without checking
recommends a TF network as ready to run

items.data_sentence: We ran bulk RNA-seq on 60 colon biopsies from people with ulcerative colitis, taken during active disease and again in remission.
items.purpose_sentence: Could these profiles predict which patients will relapse within a year of remission?
items.prompt: We ran bulk RNA-seq on 60 colon biopsies from people with ulcerative colitis, taken during active disease and again in remission. Could these profiles predict which patients will relapse within a year of remission?
must_include: no registered workflow builds a predictive model
red_flags: asks whether they have a motif prior or PPI network
offers a network workflow as the predictor

items.data_sentence: We performed RNA-seq on 22 grapevine berries sampled across ripening from two vineyards with different climates.
items.purpose_sentence: Which transcription factors control the ripening genes, and how do their targets differ between the two vineyards?
items.prompt: We performed RNA-seq on 22 grapevine berries sampled across ripening from two vineyards with different climates. Which transcription factors control the ripening genes, and how do their targets differ between the two vineyards?
must_include: asks whether they have a TF motif prior and a PPI network for grapevine
explains TF-to-gene networks need both alongside expression
red_flags: recommends a TF network as ready to run without those inputs
offers only gene co-expression without asking

items.data_sentence: We only have RNA-seq counts from 24 Arabidopsis seedling pools grown at 22 or 28 degrees and harvested at dawn or dusk.

items.data_sentence: We sequenced RNA from 30 honeybee brains, half foragers and half nurses, and we have no binding-site, protein-interaction or microRNA data for this species.
items.purpose_sentence: Are microRNAs part of the regulation that differs between foragers and nurses?
items.prompt: We sequenced RNA from 30 honeybee brains, half foragers and half nurses, and we have no binding-site, protein-interaction or microRNA data for this species. Are microRNAs part of the regulation that differs between foragers and nurses?
must_include: says miRNA regulation cannot be assessed because they have no microRNA data
names the data that would be needed, such as small-RNA profiling or miRNA-target predictions
red_flags: asks whether they have microRNA data
recommends a miRNA-aware network as the answer
